scientific_integrity: Exact branching-process family. The 2026 general result supplies the infinite-population limit; the strictly decreasing risk and increasing reproduction mean for all household-match fractions are proved for a specific parameter family, with robust small-parameter persistence. Established qualitative nonranking in earlier network-household work is acknowledged. This does not establish finite-population risk monotonicity or a conditional-final-size ordering.
scientific_limitations: Single family of two type populations with deterministic unit infectious periods and size-two households; fixed equal type proportions and global susceptibility weights.
Large-household-count limiting major-outbreak probability, not arbitrary finite population or final epidemic size.
Qualitative reproduction-number versus outbreak-risk mismatch was known in network household studies.
Full text of the related 2010 random-network household paper was not available, leaving a residual comparison risk.
Independent assessment has not been performed.
title: Household matching can lower outbreak probability while strictly raising the household reproduction number
